title: intent_reduce chunk closes leave pnl NULL: 81 of 114 rows never settled -> booked P&L omits the reduced quantity
blocked_on: manager: pull-and-deploy, then system-action backfill-intent-reduce-pnl dry-run (compare to replica: bybit_2 +0.24 / bybit_portfolio +188.11 / bybit_1 +14397.29 net), then apply: true
note: MEASURED 2026-10-10 via diag journal?table=trades (6563 rows, all pages): rows with exit_reason=intent_reduce_executed n=114, pnl NULL n=81 (bybit_1 paper 66, bybit_portfolio 8, bybit_2 real_money 7). Design (execute.py:1770-1778, order_monitor.py:7999) defers chunk PnL to the local-PnL sweep / closed-pnl lookup; 33 of 114 were settled so a settler exists but 81 never were. Example: bybit_1 6532 reduced 5117.3 of 12603.6 XRP at 1.3898 vs parent 6527 entry 1.3464; parent 6527 pnl -419.98 is computed on the REMAINING 7486 units only, so about -222 USD of realized loss sits on no row. ESTIMATE (reduce fill vs parent entry x consumed over 147 allocations) = +28.7k USD unbooked across the journal, sign and size NOT verified (pyramided parents have averaged entries) - an upper-bound probe, not a figure. DONE WHEN: (1) established why the sweep skips these rows (read the settler); (2) either a backfill with provenance ESTIMATED lands or the rows are documented as intentionally excluded and the paper-book tracker and performance-review say so. 2026-10-11 lane session_012h5mfFx5doTB4cYjaYF7gd. ROOT CAUSE (code): a PARTIALLY consumed intent_reduce parent is SHRUNK (execute.py apply_intent_reduce_partial_close), so its later close prices only the remaining units; the reduce audit row defers pnl to a parent that never books it -> no settler exists. CORRECTION: the '33 settled' were the BL-20260711 phantoms (local_markprice, reconcile_status=superseded) -- 0 of 114 reduce legs carry a real pnl. MEASURED 2026-10-11 diag journal?table=trades all 6572 rows: 114 legs, 81 NULL (bybit_1 66, bybit_portfolio 8, bybit_2 7). FIX #17577 (Tier-2 hold): src/runtime/reduce_leg_settlement.py (parent ENTRY fill vs reduce fill from exchange_fills, partial allocations only, net of pro-rated reduce fees, exit_price_source=exchange_fill MEASURED; else NULL + reduce_settlement=unverified) + monitor sweep (last 3d) + dry-run-first system-action backfill-intent-reduce-pnl. REPLICA DRY-RUN (local copy of journal + /api/bot/pnl/exchange/fills 90d): bybit_2 [real] 7 settled net +0.24; bybit_portfolio 7 settled/1 refused net +188.11; bybit_1 53 settled/13 refused net +14397.29. Hand check 6532 = -214.74 net. Side findings: PI-20261011-YJAYF7GD-0001..0004. CLOSES WHEN: VM dry-run delta read, apply run, and diag journal shows intent_reduce_executed rows carrying notes.reduce_settlement (settled ones pnl non-NULL). 2026-10-11 #17577 MERGED (not deployed, not observed). CLOSES WHEN: (1) the VM dry-run of backfill-intent-reduce-pnl is read and applied; (2) diag journal?table=trades shows every intent_reduce_executed row with notes.reduce_settlement set and settled rows pnl non-NULL; (3) a reduce leg closed after deploy is settled by the monitor sweep within 24h (notes.reduce_settled_by=reduce_leg_settlement).
